Meta.title: Portfolio | Nicolas Wadoux - Fullstack Developer
Meta.description: Portfolio of Nicolas Wadoux. Fullstack, web and mobile developer. Specialist in Javascript, Typescript, Angular, PHP, Laravel, SQL.

presentation.hello: Hello and welcome to my portfolio! As a Fullstack Developer, I thrive on contributing to meaningful projects.
presentation.why: Why this career? Because I love to understand and build with a clear purpose. What will be the positive impact of this project? To me, web development isn't just about building features, it's about creating ethical, high-performance, sustainable, and useful tools.
presentation.team: A firm believer in team spirit, I love working on collaboration. I enjoy learning from my peers as much as sharing my knowledge to reach our goals together.
presentation.location: Currently based on the Geneva border, I’m happy to work in the Geneva, Annecy, or Paris areas! Naturally curious and a traveler at heart, I am also open to international opportunities!
presentation.contact: Whether you're here for recruitment, to discuss an innovative project, simply to exchange ideas or say hello, feel free to contact me!
